primary_heading.usage: Used for all major romantic declarations, password prompts, and title screens. Delivers a gothic, 19th-century editorial feel.

script_accent.usage: Used strictly for the 'You are the reason...' reveal and personal, handwritten notes.

body_utility.usage: Used for timeline descriptions, editor inputs, and UI elements. Clean, modern, and highly legible on mobile.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use an SVG noise overlay (opacity 0.03) fixed across all screens to kill the digital flatness and give it a film/paper texture.
visual_enhancers.cobwebs: Pure SVG cobwebs placed in top corners of the Void screen. Set opacity to 15% and use 'mix-blend-mode: screen' or subtle stroke colors.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40' for the bottom navigation bar and editor modals in the Alive state.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Alive state cards should use a diffuse, warm shadow: 'shadow-[0_20px_40px_-15px_rgba(220,38,38,0.1)]'.

grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Strictly mobile-first. Max width 100vw, full height 100dvh. Hide scrollbars completely.
grids_and_layouts.void_screen: Flex center. Absolute positioning for cobwebs. Minimalist.
grids_and_layouts.swipe_deck: Relative container taking up full available height minus nav bar. Cards are positioned absolute in the center. Use Framer Motion drag constraints.
grids_and_layouts.timeline: A vertical flex container. A 2px absolute vertical line down the left edge (or center). Items are offset cards with small pulsing dots on the line.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous padding. p-6 or p-8 for standard card internal spacing. Massive margins (mb-12) between timeline sections.

void_to_alive_transition.action: Flash bang effect (background color animates 0.1s to pure white). Flatline scales up and transitions into an aggressive heartbeat path. The shattered heart SVG paths translate and rotate back into a perfect whole.
void_to_alive_transition.audio: Programmatic Web Audio API beep (low pitch) shifting to a warm, resonant heartbeat double-thump.

motion.swipe_cards: Framer motion 'drag="x"'. Rotate on drag: useTransform(x, [-200, 200], [-10, 10]). Opacity fades on exit. Next card scales up from 0.95 to 1.
motion.timeline_reveal: Scroll-triggered. Items slide up 20px and fade in. 'whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} viewport={{ once: true, margin: "-50px" }}'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the dark text in the Alive state hits APCA thresholds against the off-white background.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap the flash-bang and complex heartbeat animations in a check for 'prefers-reduced-motion'.
accessibility.touch_targets: All bottom nav items, buttons, and swipe areas MUST be at least 48x48px.

media.audio: Use simple Web Audio API oscillators for the flatline (continuous sine/sawtooth) and heartbeat (low-frequency pulsed sine). NO external audio files to keep it offline-friendly.
media.svg_assets: Inline SVGs ONLY. No external image requests. Use path animations.

3d_libraries.usage: None required. Framer Motion and standard SVG path animations are sufficient and better for mobile PWA battery life.

image_urls.instructions: The prompt specified 'Simple SVG/CSS assets (no external image URLs)'. For the timeline images, rely on the user uploading via base64 in the editor, or use elegant CSS/SVG placeholders.

components.description: The gothic entrance. Dim. Accepts two passwords.
The interactive SVG heart that mends and shifts the app from dark to light.
Tinder-style swipeable cards for 'Reasons Why'. Built with framer-motion.
Brutalist white UI for CRUD operations on localStorage.

instructions_to_main_agent: INITIALIZE THE PWA: Ensure manifest.json has 'display': 'standalone', 'orientation': 'portrait', and a theme_color that dynamically updates via meta tag based on the state (Void = #050505, Alive = #FCFBF9).
STORAGE: Create a robust localStorage wrapper in a utility file (`storage.js`). It must initialize default placeholders if empty, so the user sees a beautiful empty state or sample data.
STATE MANAGEMENT: Use React Context or Zustand to manage the global state: 'auth_role' (null | 'user' | 'editor') and 'app_stage' ('gate' | 'void_heart' | 'alive_main').

AUDIO: Write a custom hook `useHeartAudio.js` that uses `window.AudioContext` to generate the tones. This bypasses the need for assets. Flatline = continuous ~400Hz oscillator. Heartbeat = two rapid pulses of ~60Hz.
ROUTING: Since it's a simple PWA, you can use conditional rendering based on 'app_stage' instead of complex react-router setups. For the main alive state, use a bottom tab navigation.
SVG DESIGN: The broken heart MUST be constructed of distinct `<path>` elements so they can be animated independently. The flatline is a single `<path>` layered over it.
TESTING IDs: Ensure EVERY interactable element has a 'data-testid' (e.g., 'data-testid="password-input"', 'data-testid="heart-trigger"').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Dark colors look good when used independently.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical spacing where possible.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating elements like the bottom nav.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Always target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in CSS.
Always use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with specific hover/tap states.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use Lucide React.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (Framer motion 'whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}').
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize named exports for components and default exports for pages.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Optical alignment over geometrical alignment. Adjust paddings manually if an icon throws off the visual center.
In the void state, rely on negative space and extremely low contrast to create a feeling of emptiness.
In the alive state, use negative space to create a feeling of clarity and breathability.
Ensure all swipe gestures have satisfying physics (spring animations, not linear tweens).
Provide immediate visual feedback for all touches, as PWAs lack native touch feedback.
